test_title: PYST 22: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 13 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He was late for the meeting _____ the traffic jam.
solution:
The correct answer is '**because of**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**because of**" is used to indicate the reason or cause of something.
 
• In the sentence, the reason for being late is the traffic jam, so "**because of**" is the appropriate choice.
 
• **Option 1** ("because") is incorrect because it requires a clause (e.g., "because there was a traffic jam").
 
• **Option 3** ("as a result") is inappropriate because it does not fit the sentence structure.
 
• **Option 4** ("owing for") is grammatically incorrect; the correct phrase is "owing to."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He was late for the meeting **because of**__ the traffic jam."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "because"** requires a subject and verb to form a clause, which is missing in the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "as a result"** is a phrase used to show the consequence of an action, not the cause.
 
• **Option 4: "owing for"** is incorrect; the correct form is "owing to," which could also work in this context but is not one of the provided options.
